query.text: 学习助手，请陪孩子写作业，留意学习状态，持续分心时提醒他回到作业。
query.text_en: Learning Assistant, please accompany the child while doing homework, monitor their learning state, and remind them to get back to work if they are continuously distracted.

annotation.text_zh: 把手机收起来写作业吧。
annotation.text_en: Put your phone away and do your homework.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
